```{r}
#| label: generate-pca-analysis
#| include: false
input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
input_dir <- if (length(input_file) == 1L && nzchar(input_file)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
} else character()
ancestor_dirs <- function(path) {
  out <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    parent <- dirname(tail(out, 1L))
    if (identical(parent, tail(out, 1L))) break
    out <- c(out, parent)
  }
  out
}
parents <- unique(unlist(lapply(c(input_dir, getwd()), ancestor_dirs)))
candidates <- unique(c(input_dir, getwd(), file.path(parents, "blog", "posts", "post1")))
valid <- vapply(candidates, function(path) {
  file.exists(file.path(path, "code", "run_analysis.R")) &&
    file.exists(file.path(path, "code", "build.py"))
}, logical(1))
if (!any(valid)) {
  stop("Keep the full post1 folder together, including code/ and data/.", call. = FALSE)
}
post_dir <- normalizePath(candidates[which(valid)[1]], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(post_dir, "code", "run_analysis.R"), local = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
run_blog1_analysis(post_dir)
```
